model_conventions.copy: Dictionary fit on discovery only; candidates repeated>=2 at lengths4,8,12,16,24,32; greedy nonoverlap coverage max128; dictionarysize selected in0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128 by discovery totalbits only;4bit selector charged; exactDP parsing; flag+fixedwidth tokens; gamma lengths; dictionary charged.
model_conventions.markov1: Discovery start/transition counts serialized with gamma(count+1), alpha=.5 predictive probabilities; ideal arithmetic length+2bits perbook; counts frozen forholdout.
model_conventions.uniform: Fixedwidthceil(log2K) literals+gamma booklength; alphabet description common/omitted;2bit family selector.
model_conventions.bit_measurement: Explicit ideal two-part description estimates, not measured gzip bytes. Fixedwidth copy tokens have exact integer lengths; Markov arithmetic contribution is fractional with stated overhead.

proposed_copy_dominance_discriminator.warning: This is a structural, predeclared illustrative rule, not a learned semantic classifier.

variant_prediction.note: Fixed split was already exposed. Imported row0 and allowed code lists use entire public corpus. No fresh semantic holdout.

leave_component_out.limit: Only exact8-symbol edges removed; shorter/transformed dependencies persist.

limitations: No test here establishes authorial origin, message absence or plaintext. A short generator can describe encrypted language as well as nonsemantic motifs.
No prospective external Tibia plaintext pair; tiny reserved component and shorter/transformed reuse remain.
row0 is imported and inferred on the full public corpus; label alphabet and permissible codes are global conditions, not independently learned truth.
Control positives use one author and overlapping windows; copied prose contains real English fragments, not necessarily coherent whole-book essays.
Dictionary candidate frequency uses overlapping windows as a heuristic; exactDP and paid dictionary prevent counting those overlaps as achieved savings.
Comparisons cover three fixed finite coding models, not all linguistic tokenizations or every generative model.
